name: stream-machine-streamdeck
description: Local Stream Deck tools that lay out OBS buttons on a USB deck.

interface.longDescription: Runs a local stdio server that drives the original 15-key Stream Deck over USB. It previews and applies a layout of OBS scene, audio, record, and stream buttons. Requires Bun, and the Elgato Stream Deck app must be closed. Desktop only.
defaultPrompt: Preview a Stream Deck layout from my OBS scenes.
